intro:
I'm passionate about **continuous learning, exploring new technologies, and improving my development skills**. I enjoy experimenting with modern tools and frameworks to find better ways to build scalable, maintainable, and user-friendly applications.

My primary focus is **frontend development with React.js**, where I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, reusable components, responsive UI, and REST API integrations. I also have hands-on experience with modern UI technologies such as **Material UI, Tailwind CSS, SCSS, and Shadcn UI**.

Along with frontend development, I have practical experience in **Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, and Docker**, which allows me to contribute across both frontend and backend layers.

I also work with development and collaboration tools such as **Git, GitHub/GitLab, Postman, SonarQube, Vitest, React Testing Library, and AI-assisted development tools**. I'm always interested in learning better approaches, exploring emerging technologies, and applying them to real-world projects.
